text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival.
Many fans arrived this year as well, eager to see their favorite Umamusume up close, but—

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what "something important to discuss" could be?
Maybe it's some good news.

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No, but this serious mood
is really something else.
Ugh, now I'm getting nervous...

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Her social media updates have been sparse lately...
Don't tell me... she's not retiring, is she...?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Y-You idiot! Don't jinx it!
I'm sure it's gotta be some kind of surprise!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I sounded a bit too serious.
Saying 'I have an important announcement for all my fans' and all.
choice_data_list: This is actually important, so I'm not lying, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, when I searched my name, there was crazy speculation everywhere...
And near the bottom of the search suggestions,
even "retire" showed up, so—
choice_data_list: All the more reason all eyes are on you today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
you can be surprisingly shrewd sometimes, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —It's about time. Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thanks for comin' out to see me today~!
To everyone watchin' the stream, I'm real happy you're here too~!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness, it's the usual Tarumae-chan!"
"So relieved to see she's doing well~!"
"I wish I could've gone in person!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna enjoy a concert with everyone right away♪
Will ya listen to my song—?!"

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fans
text_block_list.text: (I'm all eeeaaars---!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~!
And now, the first song is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mini-live went smoothly with plenty of excitement, until it was time for the MC segment—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for all your amazing energy♪
We're heading into the second half of our mini-live now, but—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have something very important to tell you all today,
so please... lend me a little bit of your time.

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't the atmosphere feel a bit different?"
"Wait, what? No, that's creepy."
"What's the matter...?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
Tarumae's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Phew, what a relief...~
I mean, I'm glad, but...
Did Tarumae always talk like this...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What I'm about to tell you now is why I'm a local idol, and why I run in races.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There is something I wish to convey to all of my dear fans...
Allow me to use this opportunity to do so.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ————"Hometown."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that...
what was the first thing
that came to your mind?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it's the scenery of my beloved town, filled with so many childhood memories.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be the gentle expression of someone
whose mere presence warms your heart?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is it a special place just for you,
where you can be at peace, bound by nothing?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I believe that every single one of those places that came to mind—
is an equally precious 'home.'

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...And I have one too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An important...
irreplaceable "hometown"—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Ever since I was little, I've loved going to the Port of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"A giant ship approaches the stately port,
parting the sea as it draws near... It's so cool."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The vast surface of Lake Utonai
reflecting the open sky was so beautiful, too...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Watching the migratory birds relax there always makes me lose track of time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The townsfolk are so kind. Whenever I visit,
they give me freshly made haskap jam to take home...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There are lots of parks too.
I used to play there all day long.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Such a warm, lovely town.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "That is my precious hometown... Tomakomai City."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Afterward, Hokko Tarumae spoke in candid words
about why she chose the path of both local idol and racing for Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At first, some slight unrest could be seen among the fans, but before anyone realized it, everyone was listening quietly to her words—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—The me that all of you are cheering for is standing here today
because of Tomakomai—because of the town that raised me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted everyone here who's so dear to me...
to know about that today, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And—
let me state this here once again!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"As the shining light raised by Tomakomai!
Both as a local idol and a dirt Umamusume!
I'll shine brighter and climb higher than ever!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please... please continue to cheer on
someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...And that concludes the important talk.
Thank you so very much
for listening all the way to the end!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —From here on, let's switch gears and enjoy the concert to the fullest♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Was that really okay, though...?
I ended up only talking about myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had been closely monitoring the social media and stream comments, as well as the audience's reactions, from the wings of the stage.
That's precisely why I was able to make that proposal with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Please show me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed Hokko Tarumae a device
for review—

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
""I was a bit surprised, but it was nice seeing Tarumae-chan's true self~"
"You could really tell how much she loves Tomakomai.""

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck with both the local idol work and racing! I'm rooting for you!"
"Tomakomai's actually starting to sound pretty cool."
"Man, kinda makes me wanna visit my hometown again."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"‘Honestly, I wish I'd known sooner.
Maybe I had Hokko Tarumae all wrong.
Guess I'll start supporting her local idol activities too.’"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Today's mini-live really touched my heart somehow.
I'm jealous of how much she loves her hometown, and it kinda makes me want to support her even more."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: Starting today, let's do our best again!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To deliver my hometown to everyone...
I have to shine even brighter...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen draws near.
To show off Hokko Tarumae's new frontier there,
we kick into gear—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Fan Appreciation Festival,
changes had already begun to show—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —R-Really!?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "It's true! They say traffic to the city's website has spiked like never before! I heard inquiries about lodging are through the roof too!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Even so, this is so sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"It's surely the fruit of all Tarumae-chan's hard work up until now.
...Thank you so much, really."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I'm really so glad.
Though to be honest, I never imagined
such a sudden change would happen.
choice_data_list: Maybe this is part of the cause too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I showed Hokko Tarumae the Umatter posts I had just found.
They were spreading at an astonishing rate.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait... This account, if I remember right...!

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text: "I previously caused an uproar by posting that Hokko Tarumae should cut back on her locodol activities and focus on racing."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text: "Back then, I stood by what I said, believing I wasn't in the wrong. But after seeing that mini-live the other day, I realized my mistake."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text: "The origin of that running style which made me feel her immense talent lay in her profound love for Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text: "And her activities as a local idol stemmed from a desire to protect her roots, an indispensable element that shaped the way she ran."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Fueled by remorse for my presumptuous words
and a newfound curiosity, my first visit to Tomakomai
revealed a very calm and peaceful town."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text: "The shopkeepers who know Hokko Tarumae well were incredibly warm and chatty with me. The recommended seafood bowl was delicious, too."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to apologize for my rudeness the other day and offer my support once more.
Both to Hokko Tarumae, and to Tomakomai, the town that raised her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the very end of the thread of posts was a photo of the shop owner smiling warmly while holding Hokko Tarumae merchandise...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......It reached them too, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Let's move forward with confidence from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen draws near.
To show off Hokko Tarumae's new frontier there,
we kick into gear—!
